title: Celery, runner bean and egg bulgur bowls

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Bulgur, eggs, fresh vegetables, olive oil, Dijon mustard, lemon and feta are all plain whole foods or traditional staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a saucepan, a bowl and a whisk or fork, and boiling eggs and soaking bulgur suit a beginner.

works.reason: Soaking 200g bulgur in 400ml boiling water works, the beans get 3 minutes alongside 7-minute eggs, and the quantities suit four lunches.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes of active work covers slicing the beans, celery and spring onions, making the dressing and peeling the eggs, and the eggs cook while the 15-minute soak runs.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and parsley, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A fresh, crunchy grain salad suits late July, and four sticks of celery plus the leaves make it a main ingredient rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain bulgur, eggs, feta and plenty of vegetables make a balanced, filling lunch.
